overall_notes: Slate carries 6 strong morning keeps (all clean devigged, carry status validated). Two of the four new legs are problematic: Pospisil relies on a single-book pair with 7.5% hold (drafter flagged low confidence), and Shannon faces direct material uncertainty with Edwards out (drafter also noted low confidence). Cut both new uncertain legs; keep the 8 solid ones with established devigged edges and volume reasoning.
